prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. High-fidelity mobile app UI design comp. Flat frontal screenshot of one phone screen at 390x844 viewport proportion.

Surface: The Ranger's Road, "Monthly check-in": a private, offline training app screen where the person records body measurements and a few simple physical tests once every 28 days. The visitor's job: read what the last month of readiness checks already shows, then enter today's numbers and save. It must read instantly as a working app form.

Reference image: it carries the visual world to keep exactly: header bar, warm paper page, serif plus sans pairing, small spaced-caps field labels, bordered fields with large serif numerals, pine button docked above the tab bar, bottom tab bar. Do NOT copy the reference's content (no walk, miles, terrain or effort scale); this screen's content is described below.

Layout, top to bottom:
1. Header bar as in the reference.
2. A text link with a left arrow: "Back to Journal".
3. Large serif page title "Monthly check-in", and under it a quiet sans line in secondary ink: "Day 29 · Monday, October 12".
4. Serif section heading "The last 28 days".
5. A full-width Parchment Tint panel (read-only, no border fill change on tap), 6px corners, holding: on the left, label "AVERAGE SLEEP" over a large serif numeral "6.6" with a small "hours" after it; on the right, three small stacked rows, each a label and a serif numeral: "BACK PAIN 2.4", "SHOULDER PAIN 1.1", "NECK PAIN 0.8". Along the panel's bottom edge a quiet sans line: "Averages from 22 readiness checks."
6. A thin rule, then serif section heading "Body".
7. Two fields side by side, equal width: label "WEIGHT (LB)" over a bordered field showing the serif numeral "221.6"; label "WAIST (IN)" over a bordered field showing the serif numeral "41.5". Numerals large, the visual weight of this part.
8. Label "RESTING HEART RATE (BPM)" over a half-width bordered field showing the serif numeral "68", with a help line to its right or below: "Sit quietly for 5 minutes, then count for 60 seconds."
9. Docked at the bottom, just above the tab bar, a full-width pine button "Save check-in", with a thin paper strip behind it so it reads as docked over the scrolling form.
10. Tab bar.

Text, verbatim and correctly spelled: "The Ranger's Road"; "Back to Journal"; "Monthly check-in"; "Day 29 · Monday, October 12"; "The last 28 days"; "AVERAGE SLEEP"; "6.6"; "hours"; "BACK PAIN"; "2.4"; "SHOULDER PAIN"; "1.1"; "NECK PAIN"; "0.8"; "Averages from 22 readiness checks."; "Body"; "WEIGHT (LB)"; "221.6"; "WAIST (IN)"; "41.5"; "RESTING HEART RATE (BPM)"; "68"; "Sit quietly for 5 minutes, then count for 60 seconds."; "Save check-in"; "Keep"; "Road"; "Forge"; "Journal"; "Field Manual".

Palette only: Night Forest #172B21 for the header bar, Pine #24362B for primary buttons and selected options, warm paper #F6F3EA page, Parchment Tint #E9E5D8 for quiet read-only panels, rules #D4D1C7, Gold Line #A9804A only as the selected tab's short underline, Ink #171A17, Secondary Ink #4F514D, Sage label gray #53655C. Flat surfaces with 1px borders and 6px corners, no shadows.
Type: a sturdy bracketed book serif for the page title, section headings and all numerals; a narrow humanist sans for labels, help lines, inputs and buttons. Field labels are small spaced capitals in sage gray, like the reference. No decorative fonts.
Top of the screen: the same dark forest header bar as the reference, with the small gold three-pine mark and "The Ranger's Road" in cream serif. Bottom: the same five-tab bar as the reference, "Keep", "Road", "Forge", "Journal", "Field Manual", with "Journal" selected (pine, short gold underline).
Avoid: charts, graphs, sparklines, gauges, progress rings, body silhouettes, anatomy, scales or tape-measure drawings, photos, forest scenery, maps, route lines, targets or goal weights, good/bad colors on changes, XP, points, streaks, badges, fake parchment texture, glow, 3D, device frame, status bar, hands.
